description.value: Steveston Seabreeze Adventures is a marine eco-tour operator established in 1998, running small-group whale watching and fishing charters from the historic Steveston fishing village on the Fraser River delta. Tours depart aboard either an intimate 12-passenger Zodiac or larger semi-enclosed vessels with certified marine naturalists, exploring the Salish Sea in search of whales and local marine life. Steveston itself is a popular cycling destination, and this long-running family operation sits at the heart of the waterfront among seafood stalls, heritage buildings, and artisanal breweries.
